note: Synthetic stationary fixtures; software WebGL. CPU samples omit WebGL submission and simulation/network, retain actual app/animation/HUD/world-matrix work. Neither measurement establishes real laptop FPS, 21-client network performance or live combat CPU cost.
comparison: Both variants measured freshly with the Season 1 native idle third-person camera: FOV70, pitch -.22, yaw0, zoom3.2, foot + .80 anchor and direct YXZ rotation. Same viewport, DPR1, .85 drawing scale, native antialiasing, actor/tower/enemy counts and relative layout. Any asynchronous scene assets are awaited before measuring. Different worlds/materials and ground heights; not pixel-identical scenes. S1 has no matching expedition boss, so its boss row is omitted. S1 calls/triangles include its extra vignette/composite passes: info.autoReset=false, reset once per complete frame. Original S2 and overhead-camera reports are intentionally excluded.
